hosting.domain: Configure the user's chosen domain and HTTPS on the host, then set BETTER_AUTH_URL to exactly that origin.
hosting.persistence: Production requires managed PostgreSQL and private cloud object storage. The local SQLite/files adapter is for development and tests only.

database.provider: Any compatible managed PostgreSQL service, including Supabase
database.connection: Use the provider's direct or session-pool connection URL. Keep DATABASE_URL in hosting secrets. TLS certificate verification is enabled; supply DATABASE_SSL_CA only if the provider needs an additional CA certificate.
database.migrations: Application tables and Better Auth tables are initialized on readiness. PostgreSQL advisory locks serialize schema initialization and shared mutations.
database.access: The application uses its own server-only schema. Do not expose twospace through Supabase's public Data API.

files.supabase: Create a private bucket named twospace-media. Set SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_STORAGE_BUCKET and a server-only SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY. A legacy SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is also supported. Never put these keys in NEXT_PUBLIC variables.
files.s3Alternative: Set the S3 variables and leave SUPABASE_URL unset. Configure the bucket as private and block public access using the provider's controls.
files.delivery: Images and recordings are read through membership-checked application endpoints. Raw storage URLs and credentials are not sent to the browser.

google.verification: Finish the provider consent-screen configuration and test a real account after deployment.

email.setup: Verify a sender domain, create a restricted sending API key, and set RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM in hosting secrets.
email.behavior: Cloud email accounts require email verification. Password resets use single-use Better Auth tokens and revoke existing sessions after a successful reset. Email features are unavailable until a delivery provider is configured.
checks: Verification creates a valid signed-in session
Reset email reaches an existing account
Used and expired reset tokens are rejected
Existing sessions stop working after reset
Unknown emails receive the same public reset response

sampleSpaces: Each visitor gets an isolated cloud-backed sample space when deployed. Profile switching is restricted to the two generated sample identities. Sample access expires after 24 hours.
verificationStatus: Local regression tests do not prove cloud provider configuration. A real two-account, two-device flow, private file access, OAuth callback, and email delivery must be checked against the configured deployment.
